claims: As of April 2, 2026, SpaceX Starlink 17-35 is scheduled for April 2, 2026 from Space Launch Complex 4E, Vandenberg Space Force Base, CA using a Falcon 9 at 4:03 p.m. PT with a 4-hour window.
As of April 2, 2026, SpaceX Starlink 10-58 is scheduled for April 2, 2026 from Launch Complex 40, Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, FL using a Falcon 9 at 7:52 a.m. ET.

As of April 2, 2026, NASA Artemis II is the first crewed Artemis mission with 4 astronauts to the moon, scheduled for April 2026 (TBD) from Launch Pad 39B, Kennedy Space Center, FL using Space Launch System (SLS), targeting April 2026 with opportunities starting in early April after resolving technical issues.
